items.title: Engineering memory-performant Android apps
items.summary: Slides from the DevFest Kisumu 2026 workshop. Tuning R8 keep rules, building baseline profiles, hunting memory leaks and tracing slow starts used to need specialists and weeks of work. Now you can point an AI agent at your app: the Android CLI gives it the tools, Google's Android skills give it the know-how, and you check the numbers. Covers why memory and app size matter on the phones most people use, what the Android CLI and its skills can do, two hands-on labs (shrinking an app with R8, and measuring start-up with baseline profiles by comparing medians, not single runs), and what's new from Android Dev Summit. The lesson underneath it all: the agent proposes, measurement decides. The workshop app and step-by-step guide work with any agent the Android CLI supports, such as Antigravity, Claude Code or Codex.
